svg.aria-label: Post-Quantum Blockchain for Railway Signalling. Security architecture for railway signalling systems. Jun 2026 - now. Developing a blockchain-based security architecture for railway signalling with a focus on post-quantum security. Exploring lattice-based cryptography for quantum-resistant authentication, secure communication and data integrity. Designing tamper-resistant blockchain mechanisms for secure data exchange and verification across signalling networks.
